description: Database of surface water diversion sites and daily withdrawals for the Upper Colorado River Basin, 1980–2022 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Samuel F. Lopez et al. The Colorado River drains about 8% of the conterminous United States, provides water for 40 million people, and is one of the most overallocated rivers in the world. Coverage: global (US); published in 2024. Formats: XML, ZIP, CSV, TXT, Python. The data are held in USGS ScienceBase and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
